name: codeguard
description: Cross-language code lint enforcement for AI coding assistants (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code): Java, Rust, TypeScript, Python. PostToolUse hook auto-runs the native linter on every AI-written file and blocks on failure in strict mode.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI-written code pass lint on first try
interface.longDescription: Detects project languages, runs the appropriate linter (mvn javadoc+checkstyle, cargo clippy+fmt, npx eslint, ruff check) on every file the AI writes or edits, and blocks further writes when lints fail. Ships ready-to-use .pre-commit-config.yaml templates and AGENTS.md snippets for one-line project bootstrap.
